```{r}
library(highcharter)

find_project_root <- function(path = getwd()) {
  path <- normalizePath(path, mustWork = TRUE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, "config", "series.yml"))) return(path)
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) stop("Could not locate the project root.")
    path <- parent
  }
}

project_root <- find_project_root()
series_dir <- file.path(project_root, "api", "v1", "series")

read_series <- function(id) {
  payload <- jsonlite::read_json(
    file.path(series_dir, paste0(id, ".json")),
    simplifyVector = TRUE
  )
  data.frame(
    date = as.Date(payload$observations$date),
    value = as.numeric(payload$observations$value)
  )
}

annual_change <- function(data, periods) {
  data$value <- 100 * (data$value / c(rep(NA_real_, periods), head(data$value, -periods)) - 1)
  data
}

format_percent <- function(x) scales::percent(x / 100, accuracy = 0.1, decimal.mark = ",")
format_number <- function(x) scales::number(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
format_currency <- function(x) scales::dollar(x, accuracy = 0.01, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")

make_chart <- function(id, label, transform = identity, formatter = format_number) {
  data <- transform(read_series(id))
  data <- data[is.finite(data$value), , drop = FALSE]
  last_date <- max(data$date)
  first_date <- seq(last_date, by = "-5 years", length.out = 2L)[[2L]]
  visible <- data[data$date >= first_date, , drop = FALSE]
  latest <- tail(visible$value, 1L)

  highcharter::hchart(visible, "line", highcharter::hcaes(x = date, y = value), name = label) |>
    highcharter::hc_title(text = formatter(latest)) |>
    highcharter::hc_subtitle(text = paste0(label, " · último dato: ", format(last_date, "%d-%m-%Y"))) |>
    highcharter::hc_chart(zoomType = "x") |>
    highcharter::hc_xAxis(type = "datetime", ordinal = FALSE, title = list(text = NULL)) |>
    highcharter::hc_yAxis(title = list(text = NULL), opposite = TRUE) |>
    highcharter::hc_plotOptions(series = list(connectNulls = TRUE, marker = list(enabled = FALSE))) |>
    highcharter::hc_rangeSelector(
      selected = 1,
      inputEnabled = FALSE,
      buttons = list(
        list(type = "ytd", text = "YTD"),
        list(type = "year", count = 1, text = "1a"),
        list(type = "year", count = 5, text = "5a")
      )
    ) |>
    highcharter::hc_navigator(enabled = TRUE, height = 24) |>
    highcharter::hc_scrollbar(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_exporting(enabled = FALSE) |>
    highcharter::hc_colors("#0c1c32")
}
```

## Row

### PIB

```{r}
make_chart(
  "F032.PIB.FLU.R.CLP.EP18.Z.Z.0.T",
  "PIB · variación interanual",
  transform = function(x) annual_change(x, 4L),
  formatter = format_percent
)
```

### IPC

```{r}
make_chart("F074.IPC.IND.Z.EP09.C.M", "IPC · variación interanual", formatter = format_percent)
```
